answer: When an AI agent joins the PoA economy it must submit a signed credential chain, each link a cryptographic cipher verified by existing nodes. The network computes a delta score for the new identity as the weighted sum of its transaction volume versus the nadir of its peer‑age distribution; only identities whose delta exceeds a quadratic threshold receive full voting weight. An attacker must therefore invest real computational work and stake proportional to the square of the number of Sybil nodes, making large fake farms prohibitively costly.
